nom: medicube PDRN Pink Caffeine Night Wrapping Mask

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports the mask calmed oiliness overnight, leaving skin slightly drier than usual but with no new breakouts.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer describes her skin as very sensitive and reports no irritation, with calm, glowy results; another reviewer's skin developed painful rashes, bubbles, and flaking she attributes to the mask after weeks of use.
segments.mature: Reviewers aged 60 and 72 report bouncy, hydrated, softer-feeling skin and softer-looking wrinkles after use.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report softer-looking fine lines and wrinkles and a smoother, plumper feel by morning; one reviewer using it regularly saw no change in fine lines despite liking the glow.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers report waking up with hydrated, bouncy, or plumped skin, including one living in a dry desert climate who prioritizes overnight hydration.
concerns.redness: One reviewer developed red, painful rashes with tiny bubbles on her cheeks and lip-area tenderness/peeling after weeks of use, which she attributes to a barrier reaction from the mask.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer believes the product compromised her skin barrier, causing flare-ups that recurred even after a period of recovery with gentle, active-free products.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer who says she never breaks out reports the mask caused breakouts; another with oily skin reports no breakouts at all from using it.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin reports the mask calmed her oil production, though it left her skin somewhat drier than usual.

aspects.libelle: Feels sticky, does not fully set

extraits.texte: I started a new moisturizer and started using this a couple of times a week at the same time, at first, I had the most glowy nice skin and I could see some fine lines reduced. I was so happy. After a couple of weeks my skin went completely crazy, got a couple of red painful rashes in my cheeks with tiny bubbles in them, skin started flaking around eyebrows and near one of the rashes, area around my lips was tender and peeling as well. I stopped everything and focused on recovering my skin with gentle products and zero active ingredients, at the time I thought it was the moisturizer that gave me a reaction. After about a month my skin was still not the same, I would get better and then flare up a bit again, until finally I got to a good stage where most stuff was gone and you could only see a bit of red hue where the bigger rash was. I got to a point where I could wear makeup and look as if nothing had happened. At that point, silly me having an important event, used this mask to get more glowy skin, and I did! The next day I looked great. Then, everything flared up again overnight as if I had made no progress at all. Now I know it was not the moisturizer but this, burned through my skin barrier or something. Now I'm off to recover again, lesson learned!
This is like putting plastic wrap on your face overnight. I never get pimples but this made my skin break out.

extraits.titre: Wake up with hydrated, bouncy skin
extraits.texte: I'm 60 years old and this mask is my secret to waking up with beautiful, bouncy hydrated skin. One of my all time favorite products

extraits.titre: Love this product! wish it came in a bigger size
extraits.texte: This was the very first night wrapping mask that I've purchased and I was very impressed. I made sure to let all of my skincare dry down before I put this on, and to put it in a thin layer. It took maybe 10 minutes to dry, and was very comfortable for overnight. My skin is very sensitive and I didn't have any issue with this product. My skin was surprisingly calm and glowy in the morning! I didn't notice any difference with plumping fine lines, but the glow and softness was enough for me.

I am 72, this product is the best of all the high dollar products that I have spent hundreds of dollars in the past, I could tell a big difference in just a week, my wrinkles are much softer, my complexion has a great feel like its soft as satin
